items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: But Edmund, Robert, and Clowns, all of them we played together, we come up together you see, we played together you see.

ctx.x: He never played with us because he left and went away, he went to Texas you see. He left and went to Texas. But Edmund, Robert, and Clowns, all of them we played together, we come up together you see, we played together you see. So well after that all left, well quite naturally that just left me. So now. I said well, I said it's my move now you know. So what I did Mr. Bill, I met up my mind and left. That's why I came here. ctx.x: How did you get a job with it?

Oh, we used to get a lot of work. People, them days, them days wasn't like people today, you know? Anything you do, if you take a tin pan and hit on that dance, you see? But them days, you know what I mean, that's how it was, you see? So, well, we, after that, when we began, me, Edmund Hall, Robert Hall, we all organized a little band, you see? We got a band together, then we began to play, you know, out in the country where I'm from, reserve, you see? So we played for this fella, putting here three or four…
And you did name it that then?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Oh yeah, well, Edmund, Edmund Hall, Robert, Robert Hall, he was the first one to stay with us.

ctx.x: Tell him who was in the band, he'd like to know.
Oh yeah, well, Edmund, Edmund Hall, Robert, Robert Hall, he was the first one to stay with us.

ctx.x: Well when you started off, did you have a real horn or did you make your own horn?

And we had a little club, you know? We made a club, me and Ed, Robert Hall, Ed, and all the brothers, you know? And different other fellas got together and things like that, you know?
